content.text: I wrote this from standard teaching for PANCE study, using your Blueprint answers where they apply (e.g. doxycycline for healthy outpatient CAP, bismuth quadruple w/ tetracycline for H. pylori, azithromycin for Shigella and pertussis, amoxicillin for Lyme in pregnancy). It isn't checked against your own notes or a single source. Doses and first-line choices change, so check current guidelines before using it for patient care.
